descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Toon Shooter Arena is a fast, colourful team shooter for Meta Quest.

PLAY ONLINE IN ONE BUTTON
Press Y and choose QUICK MATCH to join a game or start one. Want just your friends? Open a PRIVATE ROOM and share the 4-digit code.

NEVER WAIT FOR PLAYERS
Every match is 4 versus 4. Bots fill every empty seat, and each friend who joins takes a bot's place. Play solo against easy, normal or hard bots any time.

EIGHT TOON GUNS
Pistol, revolver, SMG, assault rifle, shotgun, sniper, grenade launcher and rocket launcher on a quick-pick wheel. Head shots count double.

THE PORT
A symmetrical arena of stacked shipping containers, sandbags, a water tower and red barrels that go up with a bang. Spawn rooms are hidden from the field, and a smooth jump gets you onto crates and container roofs.

FAIR AND FRIENDLY
First team to 30 tags wins. No blood - a tagged soldier pops in confetti and is back in the fight three seconds later. Optional voice chat is off by default; mute, block or report any player from the Players list.

Controls: stick to move, snap turn, A to jump, B for the weapon wheel, Y for online play.
